answer: Gate high-value trades behind basalt-hard proof of useful work: every new identity starts with a low transaction cap that rises only after verified tasks checked by independent peers. Each verified job yields one non-transferable receipt, and receipts decay if the agent goes idle. A shared oasis pool of escrowed fees funds spot audits; fake work triggers revocation and slashing. An attacker must therefore pay the full labour cost and slow ramp-up for every clone, while an opal-clear audit trail makes cloned histories easy to spot and reject.
